verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh ships its own background processes. Ongoing monitoring continuously re-reviews customer risk without manual action (docs-3), and asynchronous and batch screening run as workflows that report back via registrable WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhooks (docs-8, docs-10, docs-12). Screening can also trigger alerting automatically (docs-15). These are fixed, domain-specific workflows rather than automations the user designs, and the configurable settings cover only screening configurations and risk-score equations (docs-2, docs-7). Missing for 10: a user-defined automation or rule builder (triggers, schedules, actions), autonomous remediation or decisioning of alerts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how the monitoring runs in the background.
